definitions.explanation: The tendency to demand flawless results from oneself or others. Can be viewed positively (high standards) or negatively (inability to accept imperfection).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}{者|しゃ}だ。
{完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げている→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
{完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手放|てばな}す→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧ことで、かえって⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: By letting go of perfectionism, you can sometimes actually get better results.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧ (perfect, complete) + ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (-ism). Often discussed in the context of work culture, mental health, and self-improvement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}{者|しゃ}: perfectionist (person)
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into perfectionism
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手放|てばな}す→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧: to let go of perfectionism
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な: perfectionistic

THE {主義|しゅぎ} SUFFIX:
Productive suffix meaning '-ism' or 'principle of':
- {個人主義|こじんしゅぎ}: individualism
- {理想主義|りそうしゅぎ}: idealism
- {現実主義|げんじつしゅぎ}: realism
- ⟦{資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}→資本主義：05414_shihonshugi⟧: capitalism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦こだわり→こだわり：08346_kodawari⟧: insistence, attention to detail — can be positive; perfectionism focused on specific areas
- ⟦{完璧主義|かんぺきしゅぎ}→完璧主義：12298_kanpekishugi⟧: perfectionism — synonym using ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧ instead of ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧
